notes.title: New co-op climbing game! PEAK
notes.content:
Hello all SpöökTubers! 


We know you're all eager for more news about Content Warning, at the moment the game is getting ported to console and we hope to launch those versions this winter, with that launch we will also be adding achievements to the Steam version. We spoke about CW's future back in April over here.



Some of the Landfall team, once again, took a break from our main game HASTE to go to a game-jam - this time with Another Crab's Treasure devs Aggro Crab and the result was PEAK! We think some of you who love Content Warning would also like this game, and if now feel free to ignore this!



PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?



Check out PEAK

notes.title: New game HASTE and some other info!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! First off, happy 1 year anniversary to Content Warning - this time a year ago we launched CW with no idea how many people would play the game! 

We're very grateful to you all for playing Content Warning even if there haven't been many updates since launch! 🙏 It's been great seeing the mods come in from the mod support update in December. Thank you to all the modders for making such cool stuff for the community!

We've explained a bit why here, but for those of you who missed it: the CW team took a break from a longer project called HASTE to make Content Warning. Once CW was more stable after its launch, they had promised to come back to HASTE to finish it together with that team, which they did. HASTE is now released on Steam! 

With that said, we want to manage expectations going forward regarding updates.

Content Warning is not a live-service or early access game, which means that we can't promise updates with more content. The game contains what it says on the Steam store and any additional updates are a bonus. 

The CW team is made up of 5 developers, all of whom have been working non-stop on several projects for the last couple of years. At the moment, they don't know when/if they will come back to working on Content Warning, but if they do, they will have to take a break first. If they do decide to come back and make updates for the game, we will keep you in the loop!

Finding games:
If you’re having issues finding other players, we recommend checking out the CW Discord, where you can find others to play with!

Ports:
We’re working with a porting studio to get the game onto other platforms, so we hope to have more news about that this year. Porting also means we will add achievements for PC!

Re the video extraction issues:
In the last couple of patches, we, with your help, solved several issues that led to videos failing to extract. We want to thank everyone who sent in logs and other information to help us fix as many of these bugs as possible.

There are sadly a million things that can lead to extraction issues for the videos, some of which we have no control over on our end (like one teammate having a weird file structure on their computer) but we have done our best to fix the most common ones. If you are still having issues, please check out our troubleshooting page.

Support:
You can find help in our Content Warning FAQ for the most common issues. If you still need help, you can also reach out to support@landfall.se for troubleshooting or to ask questions about the game.

notes.title: Small update! Mod support and fixes 👻
notes.content:
Hello SpöökTubers and welcome to a small update! In this patch, we have some fixes but most importantly we have added mod support via the Steam Workshop!

Patch Notes: 

Added

 Controller support (rebindable using SteamInput)
 Steam Workshop support for mods

Fixes

 A bunch of defibrillator fixes, for example not being able to speak after being rezzed
 Fixes related to the extraction failing when you try to get your video
 Expanded shadow settings allow for higher-quality shadows
 Made tooltips correctly display rebindable keys
 Made select items 1-3 rebindable
 Matchmaking now prioritises lower ping matches


Why mod support?
When we launched CW there were immediately a bunch of really cool mods being made, so we're super happy to make it possible for those mods to be on the Steam workshop! 

The CW team is small and doesn’t have enough capacity for continuous updates alongside their other work, so having mod support is a great way to empower the community to create cool new stuff! We had hoped to have this up and running earlier but it took a little longer than expected. 

If you are a modder, here is the current documentation for creating and uploading mods: https://github.com/landfallgames/ExampleCWPlugin

There’s also an unofficial modding Discord you can join to find out more about Content Warning mods.

We can’t wait to see what kind of mods you all create!

Re the video extraction issues:
In the last couple of patches we, with your help, solved several issues that led to videos failing to extract. We want to thank everyone who sent in logs and other information to help us fix as many of these bugs as possible. 

There are sadly a million things that can lead to extraction issues for the videos, some of which we have no control over on our end (like one team-mate having a weird file structure on their computer) but we have done our best to fix the most common ones. If you are still having issues after this update please reach out to our support at support@landfall.se so we can help troubleshoot. 

Future updates:
As we spoke about in our last patch, the dev-team is made up of five developers who took some time off from their main project to work on Content Warning. 

The other project has been in the works since 2021 together with a bigger team, so it’s important to the devs that they come back to finish it. As we explained in our latest post, they won’t work more on CW during this time. Therefore, we don’t know when or if there will be more Content Warning updates. 

That said we’re very happy with what Content Warning has become! It’s been a wild ride for a six-week project that blew all of our expectations out of the water. We’re thankful to you all who have been on this journey down to the old world with us so far, and we can’t wait to see what mod support brings!

Finding games:
If you’re having issues finding other players, we recommend checking out our Discord where you can find others to play with https://discord.gg/contentwarning

Ports:
We’re working with a porting studio to get the game onto other platforms, so we hope to have more news about that next year. Porting also means we will add achievements for PC!

Support:
You can find help in our Content Warning FAQ for the most common issues if you still need help you can also reach out to support@landfall.se for help troubleshooting or to ask questions about the game.

Fixed:

notes.title: Content Warning Small Patch fixing various issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The devs are back from a short break and working on bug fixes, thank you all for reporting issues and sending us detailed information and logs - if you experience more issues after this update please send us new logs and reports to support@landfall.se so we can take a look!

Patch Notes: 

🪲 Fixed issue where recording player's voice would be too low
🪲Localization Fixes
🪲 Fixed some issues with video extraction failing - we are still looking into this
🛠️ Added more logging to help us figure out the video extraction issue


Please send us your logs if video extraction fails with the new update! This will help us figure out why it is happening so we can fix it!

The player log contains information on your latest game session which can help us track down bugs. Recreate the bug you’re experiencing in the game before getting the log here:

[olist]
 Press and hold the Windows key and the letter R on your keyboard 
 Type appdata into the prompt that appears 
 Then navigate to LocalLow\Landfall Games\Content Warning> locate the file called “Player” and send it to support@landfall.se
[/olist]
  
We know a lot of you are wondering about content updates, we're currently focusing on fixes and quality-of-life features. As we've spoken about in the past we don't do estimates for updates as it leads to crunch for the team but we will let you know when and if a new update is on the way! :)

notes.title: New update! New map, monsters, items, sponsorships and meta progression 👻
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here's the first big update to Content Warning! We've added a bunch of new stuff like a new map, monsters, items, meta progression etc. We've also fixed some of the bugs and put in more logging to see if we can fix the rest. 


Patch notes:

Added:

🎉 Added a new map
🎉 Added 13 new monsters
🎉 Added new item, Rescue hook
🎉 Added a hat shop
🎉 Added unlockable sky island upgrades
🎉 Added sponsored video deals that can be picked after the first week
🎉 Added MetaCoins for purchasing island upgrades and hats
🎉 Added a new rare cursed item in the old world
🎉 Added a mirror in the house
Changes/improvements:

🛠️ Changed level selection to random
🛠️ General Monster Balancing
🛠️ Various audio improvements
🛠️ Slightly boosted player voice range
🛠️ Reworked modding matchmaking
🛠️Optimized video network performance to get faster extractions in some cases
Fixes:
🪲Fixed VSync not working after using the dive bell.
🪲Fixed some sound issues including the sound echoing too much
🪲Fixed issue where players would fall through the map when sleeping on the ceiling
🪲Fixed issue where the camera would sometimes not go into the video extraction machine
🪲Fixed issue where the game would end when you surface with only the broken camera 
🪲Fixed issue where the boom mic would extend your body’s hit-box
🪲Fixed issue where the shock stick would only work once on monsters or team-mates
🪲Fixed issue where holding an item when going up or down with the diving bell would cause issues picking up other items
🪲Fixed issue where holding an exploding bomb would delete the player holding it
🪲Fixed issue when the last player alive left you would not return to the surface
🪲Possible fix for the dive bell door bug
🪲Possible fix for the audio popping issue
🪲Possible fix for defibrillator speed bug


We’re still looking into the other bugs reported with the Extraction bug being one of our priorities, with this update we’ve added logs to see if we can figure out what goes wrong. If the Extraction Failure bug happens to you please send us your logs (Found in: Appdata/Local Low/LandfallGames/Content Warning/player.log and player-prev.log while the game is still running) to support@landfall.se so that we can have a look, your logs may be the key to fixing it. 

If you’re having issues please check out our FAQ landfall.se/content-warning-faq for some common fixes.     


Enjoy!

PS our friends over at HappyHead Games just released their new game Spanky! if you like physics multiplayer games you should check it out.

notes.title: Oh wow!!! Content Warning is now paid after being claimed by over 6 million!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The last 24h have been a wild ride to say the least, never did we imagine that we would get over 200K concurrent and over 6.2 MILLION owners of the game in 24h - THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH!

It's been a real treat watching all of your videos and we are so happy that we've managed to create something that makes people have fun together. 

Now the game has gone paid - it's available for 7.99USD for those of you who didn't get it during the free promotion - for those of you who did, you get to keep the game forever!

We know there are lots of bugs and server issues, we assure you that we are working on it. 

Content Warning is made by a very small team of devs (only 5 people) so fixes may take a little while but we promise you we are doing our best to solve the issues. 

Currently the main issues we're looking into are: 

⚠️Issues with voices 
⚠️Connection and hosting issues
⚠️Issues with camera footage not extracting
⚠️Issues with camera footage not being visible 

A lot of these we have leads on already and are hoping to have some fixes for tomorrow morning. 

If you have any bugs to report, crash logs to send, or other questions please reach out to support@landfall.se and we will get to you as quickly as we can. 

Keep Spööking, 

The Content Warning Team

notes.title: CONTENT WARNING is free for the first 24h!
notes.content:
CONTENT WARNING is free for the first 24h! 

Every year for April 1st aka Landfall Day we do something special, this year we’re releasing Content Warning for free for anyone who downloads it between now 9AM PT and 9AM PT tomorrow April 2nd. 

We do this as a special treat to our community so that as many people as possible will have the chance to play the game. 

After the free period, the game will cost 7.99USD

Thank you all for celebrating Landfall Day with us!
